comment: A bank is eleven scales of twenty-one notes, 231 in all; the twenty-first note of each scale is the target the ring morphs towards rather than a note the filters sit on. The ten figures on the right are one parameter each (PARAMETER_PARAM 0 to 9) whose name, description and greying are rewritten when the TYPE switch changes page (RainbowExpander.cpp:439-558), which is why each of their lines has to cover three meanings. The maker's own descriptions for the JI page call Upper the denominator and Lower the numerator, which is the wrong way round against the manual and against the arithmetic. The module has no inputs and no outputs; everything reaches Rainbow through the expander connection, and only when TRANSFER is pressed. Frequencies are held between A0 at 13.75Hz and A10 at 28160Hz (RainbowExpander.cpp:258-259).
